meta.name: Boarding House Blues
meta.description:
Title: Boarding House Blues
Summary: Tenants of a Harlem boarding house put on a show to save their home.
Directed by: Josh Binney
Actors: Moms Mabley, Dusty Fletcher, Marcellus Wilson
Production Company: All-American News
Release Date: September 1948 (USA)
Aspect Ratio: 1.37 : 1
   Despite the slapstick atmosphere there, the inhabitants of Moms' theatrical boarding house in Harlem are broke and in danger of losing their home. For some ready cash, they trick a producer into helping them put on a show, featuring a variety of black specialty acts.
